items.text: SUMMARY OFTHEPROPERTIESOF IONISINGRADIATION

items.label: text
items.text: We have said that ionising radiation causes uncharged atoms to lose electrons. An atom that haslost(or gained) electrons has an overall charge.It is called an ion.The three types of radioactive emission can all form ions.
